name: Sicaran Ruststalker

bonuses.name: Heavily Augmented
bonuses.text: A Skitarius' body is designed to withstand the rigours of war. Skitarii do not bleed and they gain +3d to toughness rolls made to resist radiation, corrosion, and environmental energy hazards.

abilities.name: Attacks
abilities.text: Each Sicaran Ruststalker will either have two Transonic Blades or a Transonic Razor and a Chordclaw:

options.name: Sicaran Princeps
options.text: A Princeps functions much in the way of an Alpha or Sergeant, directing the activities of a squad of Ruststalkers and infiltrators. If there are at least 5 Sicarans involved in the combat, you may want to replace one with a Princeps. All Sicaran Princeps gain a +1 to fellowship and increase the AV of their Augmetic Plating by 1, to a total resilience of 11. A Sicaran Ruststalker Princeps has two Transonic Blades and may additionally take either a Chorclaw or a Transonic Razor.

note: 'Sicaran' (for Sicarian) and 'Chorclaw' (Princeps text) copied as printed. Princeps option: the 'Sicaran Princeps' sidebar (PDF p.31); it lists both extra weapons, of which the Princeps takes one.
